text:
I understand your frustration—a delayed refund after following up twice is annoying.

To help, I need a bit more detail: **When did your return reach our warehouse?** (You can check your return tracking or the email with the prepaid label.) According to policy, refunds post **5 business days** after arrival, then take an additional **5–10 business days** to show on your card depending on your bank.

If it's been longer than 5 business days since warehouse arrival, or if you'd like me to look into the specific delay given your follow-ups, **I'll escalate this to a Support Lead** who can check your account directly and expedite if needed. Just confirm the warehouse arrival date and I'll get this sorted.
